empty / damaged packet → INPUT_CONTRACT input failure (null · {} · string · wrong version · missing run_record · TC not requested · state conflict)

tests.name: same evidence, different look id / image ref / run id → identical record (provenance aside) on all 43
input order changed (component registry, fact pool and run_record keys reversed) → same direction / rule / exception / Classic-support refs on all 43
repeated execution is deterministic (43 × 3 identical records)
valid product departure → T: every look with a confirmed frozen departure is TRANSFORMATIVE, every TRANSFORMATIVE has one
Classic garments do not cancel T: adding a fully conventional garment (copy of a Classic trouser) to every T look keeps T
styling-only departure creates no T: every layer relation UNKNOWN + realized shoulder exposure on every jacket / coat / shirt → identical on 43
absence of styling observations does not block: wearing context removed (R09) and frame limits crop / occlusion / lower_body_cropped added → every scorable look keeps a C / T direction
missing evidence is never Classic evidence: removing every Classic-support fact of the 8 corrected looks (set UNKNOWN) → never CLASSIC (input failure when nothing else is observed)

tests.name: C is evidence-sensitive, not a default: completing the reported sensitive fact toward its departure flips the look to T (M269 sweater fit · M214 shirt asymmetry · F418 unknown top identified as an Oversized sweater)
tests.evidence: TRANSFORMATIVE TC-P1 DIRECT · TRANSFORMATIVE TC-P1 DIRECT · TRANSFORMATIVE TC-P1 DIRECT

tests.name: missing evidence never stops scoring: every single TC fact of every garment of all 43 set UNKNOWN in turn → never an UNRESOLVED / UNKNOWN outcome; status RESOLVED or a named input failure
TC and SR are independent: the resolver loads no SR module, and changing SR-only facts (shoulder_drop SVP-106 · waist cinch) leaves the result unchanged
no GT leakage and no look-id / REF-id rule (code scan of src/*.js, comments excluded)
no REF-id rule: anonymised component refs (c1 → k1 …) and anonymised run identity give the same result on all 43
no Vision expansion: adapter + product stage + visibility module + V1 pins are byte-identical to V2 (and the adapter / product / pins to V1)
no Item TC reopen: bound sha256 still match (Step 2 successor V4 · TC production authority · Item V1_3 rules · RC6 gates); FLV freeze id
product stage preserved: on all 43 packets the product result and every garment trace are identical to the V2 ledger
every V2 C / T is unchanged in V3 (34 looks; the correction touches only V2 DIRECTION_UNRESOLVED)
accessories added (decorative chain, wrapped scarf) to a Classic look → CLASSIC unchanged (TC-D-4b)
layering arrangement variations do not decide (jacket over sweater ↔ reversed; skirt-over-trousers relation removed / reversed; wrapped scarf on F390)
tests.evidence: CLASSIC TC-C DIRECT · CLASSIC TC-C DIRECT · TRANSFORMATIVE TC-P1 DIRECT

tests.name: shirt in an unconventional wearing position (exposure + reversed relation) → same result (M270)
no majority vote / no departure count: one departing garment among Classic ones → T; looks with ≥ 2 departures give the identical record shape and rule
no numeric score, strength, ordinal, tier (TC1–TC9), TC5, NEUTRAL or DIRECTION_UNRESOLVED in any output; no aggregation / vote in code
no styling gate in the resolver (no TC-S rule, no relation / exposure branch)
output contract: status RESOLVED ⇒ direction C / T + rule TC-P1 / TC-C + resolved_by + basis.sensitivity; TECHNICAL_EXCEPTION ⇒ direction null + exception.class INPUT_FAILURE + a listed code
every CLASSIC has Classic support resting on OBSERVED facts (each listed fact is OBSERVED in the run_record)
frame invalid (look not observed · image_failure · not_a_worn_look) → NO_OBSERVABLE_WORN_LOOK input failure; feet_not_visible alone keeps the direction
tests.evidence: INPUT_FAILURE NO_OBSERVABLE_WORN_LOOK · INPUT_FAILURE NO_OBSERVABLE_WORN_LOOK · INPUT_FAILURE NO_OBSERVABLE_WORN_LOOK · CLASSIC TC-C DIRECT

tests.name: no garment at all (accessories / footwear only) → NO_GARMENT_OBSERVED input failure

construction read-set is sound against the frozen predicate: for every garment key, no single substitution of a field OUTSIDE the read-set (frozen Item V1_3 domain) changes the frozen construction verdict
every read-set field is named by the frozen construction code (evaluator V2.2 base / V2.3.2)
authority provenance: constitution id · AEMS + Product-Only anchors · frozen pins · TC-D-3 superseded · V2 outcomes superseded
processing order does not change any result (forward vs reversed over 43)
no network module is loaded by the resolver (offline by construction)
